observedFailure: Expiry observer expected zero active SSE requests but counted seven historical requests after full document navigations.
rootCause: Chromium omits requestfinished/requestfailed for EventSource requests abandoned by document replacement. A separate real HTTP server regression measured one actual live connection while the previous observer accumulated historical request objects.
remainingCases: The idle case was interrupted and the absolute-expiry case was not executed; neither is accepted.
